purpose: Teach: キックオフ/型式/買い取っ/アダプター/コネクタ/ブランク/送り出す/圏外

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究プロジェクトのキックオフを準備しろ
lines.en: Ren — get the research project kickoff prepared.
lines.style: Clear, measured directive. Slight pause before the task. Confidence in Ren's competence implicit in the brevity. Eye contact steady, no doubt.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験装置の型式仕様書を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll review the experimental equipment specifications.
lines.style: Quick, respectful acknowledgment. Slight lean forward. Already mentally moving to the task. Quiet determination underneath politeness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、廃棄予定の装置を業者に買い取って頂け
lines.en: Ren — see if you can get the disposal equipment bought back by the vendor.
lines.style: Practical, delegating tone. Matter-of-fact phrasing. A step more conversational than the first — this is a favor-type task. Still confident he'll handle it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。海外論文のアダプター回路の論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through the overseas adapter circuit papers.
lines.style: Quick confirmation. Slight nod. Already documenting the task mentally. No hesitation, no extra words — pure compliance and quiet initiative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室のコネクタ規格を統一しろ
lines.en: Ren — standardize the lab's connector specifications.
lines.style: Firm directive without harshness. Slight weight on the task itself. This is non-negotiable, but framed as professional expectation, not punishment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会日程のブランクを利用してフィールドに出ます
lines.en: Yes. I'll use the gaps in the conference schedule to get fieldwork done.
lines.style: Efficient acknowledgment. Already thinking ahead. Respectful but showing independent problem-solving — he's not just taking orders, he's planning.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究成果を社会に送り出す道筋を考えろ
lines.en: Ren — work out a pathway for getting this research into the world.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly heavier prompt. Slower delivery — this is the bigger-picture ask. Tone shifts from task-assignment to mentorship. Genuine interest in his thinking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。山岳調査時の圏外対応プランを整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll finalize the off-network response plan for the mountain survey.
lines.style: Calm, methodical acceptance. Slight exhale on 'yes' — he's taking it all in. Measured pace. Respect in the precision of his language. A hint of quiet confidence returning.
